integrity: The finite-moment conclusion is proved from explicit tail inequalities in the cited source; convergence in probability alone is not treated as sufficient. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The estimate is one-sided and does not prove sharpness or a limiting law.
The constants depend on the fixed degree and fixed moment exponent.
The focal preprint is recent, so an unindexed equivalent formulation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Finite moments of the vertex defect for Bombieri Gaussian homogeneous polynomials
